name: zmath_approx_exp_neg
description: zMath::ApproxExpNeg lazily builds a 256-entry exp(-i / 51) table and returns a clamped lookup for x in [0, 5].
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zMath source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x474fc0 validates the __stdcall float ABI, lazy dirty flag, scale 51.0f, 256 table entries built as exp(-index * 0.0196078438f), dirty clear, x > 5 returning 0.0f, x < 0 returning 1.0f, and lookup through _ftol(scale * x).
The native smoke verifies lazy table build, scale/dirty globals, representative table entries, truncating lookup, negative clamp, upper clamp, and x == 5 using table slot 255.
